name: ODMA
summary: ODMA is a bioisosteric analogue of 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-methylamphetamine (MDMA) which was developed in an attempt to create an improved MDMA alternative for potential clinical use. It is the analogue of MDMA in which the 1,3-benzodioxole ring has been replaced with a 2,1,3-benzoxadiazole ring. TDMA and SeDMA are closely related analogues.

pharmacology.text: ODMA, TDMA, and SeDMA are releasing agents of serotonin, norepinephrine, and dopamine similarly to MDMA. MDMA and 3,4-methylenedioxyamphetamine (MDA) are well-known serotonergic neurotoxins that damage serotonergic neurons in the brain.

summaryZh: ODMA是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C10H13N3O，為MDMA（3,4-亞甲二氧甲基苯丙胺）的結構類似物，其苯並二噁戊熳環被2,1,3-苯並惡二唑環取代。
summaryZhHans: ODMA是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C10H13N3O，为MDMA（3,4-亚甲二氧甲基苯丙胺）的结构类似物，其苯并二𫫇戊熳环被2,1,3-苯并恶二唑环取代。

uses.en: It is a research compound, made in an attempt to find an MDMA-like drug that might be used in the clinic. It has no approved use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，目的是尋找可能用於臨床的類 MDMA 藥物，目前沒有核准用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，目的是寻找可能用于临床的类 MDMA 药物，目前没有核准用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It releases serotonin, noradrenaline and dopamine as MDMA does. MDMA-like drugs can cause jaw clenching, overheating, a fast heart rate, low blood sodium and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它和 MDMA 一樣會釋放血清素、正腎上腺素與多巴胺。類 MDMA 藥物可能造成咬牙、體溫過高、心跳加快、低血鈉與血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它和 MDMA 一样会释放血清素、正肾上腺素与多巴胺。类 MDMA 药物可能造成咬牙、体温过高、心跳加快、低血钠与血清素症候群。

fact.en: It swaps MDMA's methylenedioxy ring for a related oxygen-containing ring, a change chemists call bioisosteric: a different group of atoms chosen to do much the same job.
fact.zh: 它把 MDMA 的亞甲二氧基環換成相關的含氧環，化學家稱這種改動為「生物等效置換」，也就是換上不同的原子組合來擔任幾乎相同的角色。
fact.zhHans: 它把 MDMA 的亚甲二氧基环换成相关的含氧环，化学家称这种改动为「生物等效置换」，也就是换上不同的原子组合来担任几乎相同的角色。
